# Parker Schmidt

> Parker Schmidt is a director crafting cinematic creative and advertising
> films — elevating the everyday through intimate narrative and impressionist
> imagery. From the U.S., based in Los Angeles. Competed professionally in
> downhill skateboarding; studied in Berlin.

## About

Parker Schmidt is a film director working in commercial and advertising
filmmaking. His work spans brand films, documentary, and narrative content
for clients including Dodge, Srixon, Willett, Nike, Bolt, Leica Camera,
Corona, Cadillac, Kia, Lexus, Lululemon and others. Recognition includes
ADC One Club, Vimeo Staff Pick, Berlin Commercial shortlists, and a Shots
Americas nomination for New Director of the Year.
